notes: The app has no destinations in this region, so every destination below is a proposal for the owner; spots carry the proposed destination id. Ids use the proposed destination ids (never reused: none of these prefixes exist in git history).
Sydney is separate; no existing spot is misplaced.
Review items (27) and rejects (25) are untouched; see fairness.json.

Lithgow, Dubbo, Orange and Cowra have no accepted photo for the town candidate, so they are held, but they are still proposed as destinations (headers are a separate step) because their spots need a parent; Dubbo and Cowra spots are placed under them, and spots under them add only once the destination is accepted.
Spots reached from a gateway destination but inside a park span (Hartley, Zig Zag) are put under Lithgow, not under the Blue Mountains park.
